reviewer_verdicts.best_finding: The 1/31 agreement coverage was arithmetically predetermined, and the bottleneck is singletons, not disagreement: re-executing all 69 sample programs shows gold existed among the k=3 samples on 10/31 entries (oracle-selection 32.3% pass@1, 10x vote's 3.2%), but 14 entries had only ONE demo-perfect sample (8 of them gold) so the gate structurally could not fire; binomial with the measured per-arm gold rate (12/93=0.129) predicts 1.42/31 agreement events vs 1 observed. Two sharpening corrections to the committed story: (1) the chain-vs-single-shot attribution is confounded — probe iter-0 (single-shot, same prompt, SHORTER timeout) hit 12/31 entries vs fresh arms' 4/31+7/31 (2.0x gap, Fisher p=0.092), as large as the chain's own +13pp within-lineage gain, so run-to-run codex variance is not excluded; (2) one of the three disagreements (2b83f449) destroyed a GOLD answer (fresh1 was gold), so disagreement is 2/3 junk-killing, 1/3 recall cost. Empirical sims: {chain,fresh0,fresh1} doubles coverage to 2/31 at 2/2 gold; adding the CORRELATED iter-0 arm yields 10/31 agreements at precision exactly 0.5 (the unconditional rate) — independence is the entire precision signal. Near-miss clustering verified useless: at tau=0.005 nothing clusters; the first cluster (0.0061, 7b80bb43) is a wrong-wrong pair. Caveat: the sole agreement task aa4ec2a5 is a flagged content-identical ARC-1-eval reuse, omitted from the Part B artifact next to P(gold|agree)=1.0 (n=1).

synthesis.design_implication: GAP-4 precision fixes CONFIRMED by 5/5 hostile re-derivations (bit-exact), with mandatory narrowing. PART A ESTABLISHED: the graded min-hamming gate is harmless on both pools at every tau (ARC-1 pass@2 0.4516->0.5806, 0 pass@2 vote-wins lost, flat from tau=0 to tau=2.0) but the graded relaxation itself buys nothing on ARC-1 — all 4 recoveries are tau=0 exact-match fires, the 4 incremental fires in (0,0.02] are all wrong promotions on vote-dead entries (safety = pool structure from the 30/31-contaminated exact-match bimodality, NOT a measured tau boundary), and pooled band precision at tau<=0.02 is 1/7=14%. Where it pays: ARC-2 tau=0.005 fires once (7b80bb43, ham 1/493=0.00203, gold at vote rank 2), doubling pass@1 0.0323->0.0645. Production setting: tau=0.005 ONLY, plus a vote-aware guard for the tau-untouchable 25094a63 mode (exact-match wrong promotion over a 945-vote gold; the gate's sole pass@1 loss, gross +5/-1). PART B ESTABLISHED: the agreement-precision mechanism is real but k=3 single-shot coverage collapses arithmetically — 1/31 agreement (binomial predicts 1.42 at per-arm gold rate 12/93=0.129); the bottleneck is singletons (14/31 entries with exactly one demo-perfect sample, 8 gold), not disagreement. Single-shot demo-perfect rate is 18/69=0.26 vs the 3-iteration chain's 16/31=0.52 (corrected 13/23 tasks): the CHAIN is the coverage engine and fresh singles are the cheap independence check — adding the correlated iter-0 arm restores coverage (10/31 in sim) but at exactly the unconditional 0.5 precision, so independence IS the entire precision signal. Disagreement events are 2/3 junk-killing, 1/3 recall cost (2b83f449 destroyed a gold). P(gold|agree)=1/1 is n=1, CP95 [0.025,1.0], the sole event contaminated (aa4ec2a5 ARC-1-eval reuse) — NOT a calibrated precision; deduplicated with the probe it is 2/2 task-level, CP95 [0.158,1.0]. Per-(sample,entry) demo-perfect precision 12/23=0.5217 (Wilson [0.33,0.71]; per-program 9/13=0.69), consistent with the probe's 0.47-0.50. Near-miss clustering is REFUTED as an agreement extension (the only near-pair, 0.0061 hamming, is wrong-wrong), and no cheap observable separates gold from wrong demo-perfect programs (AUCs 0.43-0.62) — agreement is the only measured discriminator. RECOMMENDED SUCCESSOR (zero new codex, all from saved data): tiered harness = (1) chain+agreement hybrid — saved chained program as arm-1 + the 2 archived fresh singles, promote on exact agreement: measured 2/31 at 2/2 gold (Wilson95 LB 0.342), doubling Part B coverage for free; EXCLUDE chain-iter0 pairs (transcript provenance ambiguity + contaminated independence); (2) fallback graded gate at tau=0.005 only (tau=0.01 adds two WRONG ARC-2 promotions: 9aaea919, 6e453dd6); (3) else vote. Also measure offline the EV-optimal promote-any-demo-perfect composite (expected ~9.5/31 = 0.306 pass@1 at 0.52 precision, ~9.5x vote on a venue where vote pass@1 is 1/31), layered agreement > pool-snap tau=0.005 > singleton-promote > vote. ANOTHER CODEX RUN IS NOT JUSTIFIED NOW: scaling to k=5-7 fresh singles costs ~3.9-5.9h codex (154s/call) for binomial-projected 5.9-7.6/31 agreements, but the same model overpredicts k=3 by ~3x (3.33 predicted vs 1 observed) and 21/31 entries have ZERO single-shot-reachable gold at any k. The next codex purchase, when bought, is k=3 CHAIN arms on the ~13 chain-feasible tasks (binomial projects ~5/31 agreement-gold, ~2.5x the graded gate), which simultaneously disambiguates the chain-mechanism-vs-codex-variance confound (Fisher p=0.092); pre-register on clean tasks (exclude aa4ec2a5/16b78196) with >=5/5 clean agreement-gold events required to beat the 0.52 baseline at alpha=0.05 (0.52^5=0.038). synthesis.summary: Unanimous 5/5 CONFIRMS with key_numbers_match on every lens; every committed number reproduced bit-exact by at least two independent re-derivations from primary sources. Part A: ARC-1 vote pass@1/pass@2 0.4194/0.4516 -> gated 0.5484/0.5806 flat across all tau, fired 16/17/18/20 at tau 0/0.005/0.01/0.02, 0 pass@2 vote-wins lost, 4 recovered (gold vote ranks 65/7/3/3 — ALL tau=0 exact-match fires); ARC-2 tau=0.005 fires exactly 7b80bb43 at hamming 1/493=0.002028 (gold at vote rank 2), pass@1 0.0323->0.0645, pass@2 unchanged. Part B: 31 entries/23 tasks/46 fresh calls (7096.4 codex-s), any-of-3 18/31, agreement 1/31 (aa4ec2a5, all-gold, P(gold|agree)=1/1), per-(sample,entry) demo-perfect precision 12/23=0.5217 vs probe baseline 0.47-0.50, the three 2/3-perfect tasks all disagree; all 69 prompts byte-identical to induction_prompt, zero gold leak, pool labels match official solutions on all 20,379 candidates. The science holds; the interpretation requires four narrowings: (1) ARC-1 "safe up to tau=0.02" is vacuous, not a boundary — pass@2 stays 0.5806 to tau=2.0, all 4 incremental band fires are wrong promotions on vote-dead entries, and pooled band precision tau<=0.02 is 1/7=14%; safety is pool structure (contaminated exact-match bimodality), and 25094a63 (exact-match wrong promotion demoting a 945-vote gold, the gate's sole pass@1 loss, gross +5/-1) is untouchable by tau. (2) P(gold|agree)=1.0 is n=1 with CP95 [0.025,1.0], the sole event is a flagged content-identical ARC-1-eval reuse (undisclosed in the artifact), and pooling with the probe's 3/3 is invalid (shared program + double-counted pairs; dedup = 2 task-level events, 2/2, CP95 [0.158,1.0]) — nothing claimable above the 0.5217 baseline yet. (3) The chain-vs-single-shot attribution is confounded by run-to-run codex variance (probe iter-0 12/31 vs fresh arms 4/31+7/31, Fisher p=0.092). (4) Coverage collapse is arithmetically predetermined by singletons (14/31 entries with exactly one demo-perfect sample, 8 gold; binomial predicts 1.42/31 agreements vs 1 observed), and correlated arms restore coverage (10/31 in sim) only at the unconditional 0.5 precision — independence IS the precision signal. The MAJOR severity is purely operational: a `--part a` re-run mid-review clobbered the then-untracked artifact from 260,988 bytes to a 2,988-byte partA-only stub (the script's unconditional artifact write); Part B was reconstructed deterministically from the 69 archived transcripts, verified identical to every committed claim, and restored with a recovery_note (only per-call codex_s timings unrecoverable). As of this synthesis the restored artifact is intact and verified, but the write footgun is STILL unfixed in the script and both artifact and script are STILL untracked in git. Steelman finding worth banking: the chain+agreement hybrid (saved chained program as arm-1 + the 2 archived fresh singles) fires 2/31 with 2/2 gold at ZERO new codex cost — doubling Part B's coverage; near-miss clustering is refuted (the only near-pair, 0.0061 hamming, is wrong-wrong — direct evidence wrong programs cluster and exact-agreement precision will not hold asymptotically); no cheap observable separates gold from wrong demo-perfect programs (all AUCs 0.43-0.62, noise at this n) — agreement is the only measured discriminator.
